scope: Approved DNS-SD bootstrap slice only. This is not a workflow phase or physical pen acceptance.

checks: Local provisioning dry-run succeeded from a different cwd before test coordinators started; neither HTTP fetch nor SSH ran.
Production ARM64 bundle installed offline into a new private prefix with no coordinator file or binary execution; repeat installation refused.
The same real coordinator accepted IPv4 loopback, IPv6 loopback, and a configured non-loopback desktop address.
Real multicast DNS-SD discovery resolved Avahi SRV/TXT/address data and the native client checked matching HTTP health without a URL.
Two simultaneous clients remembered different coordinator IDs; an unselected client refused multiple candidates rather than choosing the first.
The selected client downloaded and verified the actual production bundle through the discovered endpoint.
Closing the owned D-Bus registration withdrew discovery; a remembered missing coordinator did not switch to the remaining one.

buildWarnings: Vite ignored use client directives in dependencies.
Vite reported chunks larger than 500 kB.

limits: No old prototype takeover, cleanup, event, or projection changes.
